reason_for_augmentation: Base outcome-blind linkage cannot reach the preregistered N>=1000 covered-efficacy gate because only 610 base-linked records overlap frozen non-ABSTAIN predictions; no death truth has been accessed.
anti_selection_rule: Augmentation operates uniformly on every unresolved base-linkage record and does not read frozen prediction labels or statuses.

candidate_generation.pass_1: Wikidata humans (P31=Q5) with non-deprecated day-precision P569 exactly equal to frozen A2 birth date.
candidate_generation.pass_2: Only for still-unresolved records, same retrieval for frozen A2 birth date +/- 1 day.
candidate_generation.text_fetch: wbgetentities labels+aliases in en,fr,de,it,mul, batched by QID.
candidate_generation.name_resolution: Exact copy of V0.1 normalize_name/tokens/token_signature/name_class rules embedded in V0.2.
candidate_generation.ranking: exact birth date > +/-1 day; EXACT_TOKEN_SIGNATURE > SUBSET_TOKEN_MATCH; unique top rank only.
candidate_generation.existing_links: Never modify a V0.1 LINKED QID.
